Simple Souls Set by Elvies

Source: https://elvies.itch.io/simple-souls-set
Downloaded: 2026-07-09

License summary from the itch.io asset page:
- Assets can be used in non-commercial and commercial projects, excluding NFT or blockchain-related projects.
- Users may edit the pack for their own game consistency/uniformity.
- Users may distribute the asset pack site origin/link.
- Users may not resell the original or edited asset pack.
- Credit is not necessary, but appreciated.

Ashen Pity usage:
- Source sheets are kept in assets/third_party/simple_souls/.
- Cropped runtime sprites are kept in assets/sprites/simple_souls/.
- Cropped runtime environment pieces are kept in assets/environment/simple_souls/.
